src.fastapi_server.models package

The src.fastapi_server.models contains the data models used by the FastAPI server backend, organizing the core domain entities and their schemas. It includes models related to AI model configurations, job management, material libraries, media management, and slicing operations. Each module defines the structure, validation, and serialization logic for its respective concern, enabling consistent data handling throughout the application.
